issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: the problem statement UML and textual instructions define a no-argument method messageOnRide() returning String, and the template Main() example calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. The solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implementations Pig.messageOnRide(String) and Seal.messageOnRide(String). This signature mismatch (presence of a String parameter in the solution but not in the specification/template) will cause confusion and compilation/call-site issues for students who follow the problem statement and template examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method signature across artifacts. Preferred: change the solution's Rideable interface and its implementations (Pig, Seal) to declare and implement a no-argument method public String messageOnRide() that returns "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" so it matches the UML, textual instructions, and the template Main() example. Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is intended pedagogically, update the problem statement UML/text and the template Main() example to declare and call messageOnRide(String equipment) and adjust the instructions accordingly.
